subject: Request: Rate Card Variance for Novus.ai — Hosted API Commit
messages:
From: Avery Collins <avery.collins@novus.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-10T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API pricing question / expected commit

Diego —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Novus is excited about the latency profile and the KV cache behavior for our streaming agents. Before we push to engineering, finance needs a firm view on the unit economics. A few items they asked me to confirm: 

- If we commit to a 12‑month consumption tier, what effective per‑1M‑token rate can you offer at ~2B tokens/month steady state?
- Are commit tiers strictly on the public rate card, or can we get a custom per‑token credit for the first 3 months for ramp?
- Any restrictions on model variants for committed pricing? We intend to use a mix of redwood-verified open models and one larger LlamaX trial.

I attached our projected token run-rate (high/med/low). Can you put together a short note for finance and legal on how an off‑rate-card variance would be structured (approval path, expected discounts, and SOW / billing cadence)?

—Avery
Avery Collins
Head of Platform
Novus.ai

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Collins <avery.collins@novus.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-10T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing question / expected commit

Avery —

Great questions; we can definitely put a short packet together for your finance/legal. Quick answers up front:

- For a 12‑month, 2B tokens/month commit, we can pursue a custom per‑token credit versus the standard rate card — typical direction would be a blended effective price that scales by committed tier and model mix.
- We often offer a limited introductory ramp credit (first 2–3 months) to offset integration cost; that can be included in the SOW.
- Commit pricing allows pinning to a set of model families. If you opt to trial LlamaX at higher throughput, that would be classified as a model premium and might sit on a separate SKU unless we agree to include it in the blended price.

I'll loop in Vanessa and our pricing team with a proposed variance structure and a short approval ask for legal/finance. Expect a 48‑hour reply.

Attached: your run-rate (acknowledged).

Best,
Diego
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-11T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Novus.ai — request for rate card variance (summary and ask)

Vanessa / Aditya / Priyom —

Novus (Avery Collins) is requesting a custom per‑token arrangement for a 12‑month commit at an expected steady state of 2B tokens/month with an initial 2‑3 month ramp window. Key context:

- Current public rate card: $18 per 1M tokens (hosted gpt-family baseline).
- Novus wants a blended effective price to reflect committed volume and mixed model usage; they expect ~85% open‑verified models, 15% LlamaX during trials.
- They asked explicitly for a ramp credit for first 3 months.

My proposed structure (draft):
1) Commit tier: 12 months; monthly committed tokens: 2,000,000,000.
2) Blended effective rate: Offer a 20% credit off public rate card for baseline open models, plus a model premium for LlamaX usage at +30% over blended price; net blended expected effective discount ~17% (ballpark).
3) Ramp: 50% credit on overage for months 1–3 for actual tokens above a 30% threshold to encourage onboarding.
4) Billing: Monthly invoicing with commitment reconciliation quarterly; any shortfall to be invoiced at tiered uplift.

Ask: Can Pricing/Finance sign off on up to a 25% effective discount (across blended mix) without exec approval? If not, what is the minimum approval chain and lead time for a one‑time variance?

I've attached their run-rate. I can draft the SOW language and the variance justification if you confirm the approval band.

—Diego

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-11T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Novus.ai — request for rate card variance (summary and ask)

Diego —

Thanks for the clear draft. Quick notes from Pricing Ops and Commercial Finance: 

- Approvals: Standard commercial policy allows up to 15% discount off public rate card for sales/AM approval. Anything >15% requires Head of Sales + Finance alignment and an SKU‑level memo. 
- For large commits that materially impact unit economics, Finance needs a 12‑month forecast P&L with sensitivity on model mix. Please include a worst/baseline/best margin run.
- Ramp credit is fine as a one‑time concession if tied to onboarding milestones and usage thresholds. Recommend reducing the proposed ramp credit to 40% (instead of 50%) to protect margins.

Action items for Diego:
1) Send a short 1‑page commercial memo (1x page) summarizing commitment, proposed effective discount, margin impact, and ask (sign-off band).
2) Attach the run rate workbook with the three scenarios (you already have Novus file).
3) We'll prepare a pricing variance memo template for Head of Sales + Finance signatures.

If this looks reasonable, I can commit to fast‑track review once we have the 1‑page memo. Anything above 20% goes to the executive committee and will take ~3 business days.

—Vanessa
VP Commercial
Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Novus.ai — request for rate card variance (summary and ask)

Folks —

I've drafted a short commercial memo and attached it here (proposed filename: novus_variance_memo_v1.docx). Highlights: 
- Proposed effective discount: 18% blended (falls within 15–20% band; need Head of Sales sign + Finance acknowledgment).
- Adjusted ramp credit: 40% for months 1–3, milestone gated.
- Model premium: LlamaX billed at +25% on top of blended open model price; included in blended math.

I ran a quick sensitivity: at 2B tokens/month the blended gross margin after infra & infra credits is 28% (baseline mix). Worst case (50% LlamaX) drops to ~18% — Finance wants this highlighted in the memo.

Next steps: Vanessa/Aditya — please confirm you can route this to Head of Sales and Finance for signatures (I can turn the memo into the formal pricing variance file and produce an SOW snippet).

—Priyom
Senior Commercial Analyst
Redwood Inference

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Collins <avery.collins@novus.ai>, Novus Finance <finance@novus.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-15T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Final: Novus pricing variance — next steps and DocuSign

Avery —

Thanks for the patience. Attached is a short commercial memo and a revised SOW snippet reflecting:

- 12‑month commit at 2B tokens/month; blended effective discount: 18% (as per memo).
- LlamaX model premium: +25% on LlamaX tokens; capped at 20% of monthly tokens unless pre‑authorized.
- Ramp concession: 40% credit for months 1–3, milestone gated by agent production readiness and a post‑integration health check.
- Billing: monthly invoices with quarterly commitment reconciliation.

Vanessa and Priyom have routed the memo to Head of Sales and Finance for signature. We anticipate final signed SOW and DocuSign by 2026‑09‑18 if there are no further changes. DocuSign pre‑auth link (draft, not yet signed): https://docusign.redwood.com/ENVELOPE/ABC12345

Avery — please confirm acceptance of the above and whether Novus requires any additional legal terms for LlamaX trials. Once you confirm, I'll fast‑track signatures on our side.

Cheers,
Diego
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: novus_variance_memo_v1.docx (commercial memo), proposed_sow_v1.pdf
